findings.summary: Spec prose (section 1 and Required tests) says the timeout streak ends in a 'bounds' terminal, but the implementation preserves the pre-existing streak behavior of producing terminal:'blocked' (TERMINAL_BLOCKED) via guards.streak_exceeded -> check_bounds. This is consistent with the spec's own instruction not to widen the goal_line catch and to keep current behavior, so 'bounds' reads as generic prose for 'the line is bounded'; the required behavior (typed timeout caught, round appended with worker_turn_timeout, no crash, streak ends the line) is fully delivered. Flagging only so a future reader is not confused by the wording mismatch.
